source_note: Generated only from the bundled character powers, weapons, monster attacks, character sheets, rules, and SRD-derived records.

kitk-power-acid-strike.name: Acid Strike
kitk-power-acid-strike.description: A corrosive bolt hits one target and splashes another creature adjacent to it.
kitk-power-acid-strike.resolution: Ranged power attack; adjacent creature makes Dexterity save

kitk-power-ball-lightning.name: Ball-Lightning
kitk-power-ball-lightning.description: Creates a mobile electrical sphere. It can move 30 feet as a Bonus Action and shocks creatures entering or ending in its area.
kitk-power-ball-lightning.resolution: Dexterity save; half damage on success

kitk-power-blight.name: Blight
kitk-power-blight.description: Drains moisture and vitality from one creature. Plant creatures and plant hazards have disadvantage on the save.
kitk-power-blight.resolution: Constitution save; half damage on success

kitk-power-blinding-smite.name: Blinding Smite
kitk-power-blinding-smite.description: The next weapon hit deals extra radiant damage; a failed save blinds the target, which repeats the save at the end of each turn.

kitk-power-bravado.name: Bravado
kitk-power-bravado.description: Gain temporary HP, become immune to Frightened, and grant allies Advantage on saves against Frightened while they remain in the aura.

kitk-power-chi-heal.name: Chi Heal
kitk-power-chi-heal.description: Spend 1 Chi to restore HP; spend 2 Chi to also end Poisoned or Frightened.

kitk-power-chi-shield.name: Chi Shield
kitk-power-chi-shield.description: Spend 1 Chi to gain +3 AC against the triggering attack or resistance to the triggering area damage.
kitk-power-chi-shield.resolution: Triggered when the target is hit or fails a Dexterity save

kitk-power-chill-touch.name: Chill Touch
kitk-power-chill-touch.description: Necrotic energy prevents the target from regaining HP until the start of the user’s next turn.

kitk-power-cruel-contempt.name: Cruel Contempt
kitk-power-cruel-contempt.description: A cutting performance deals psychic damage and imposes Disadvantage on the target’s next attack or social check.

kitk-power-crushing-grip.name: Crushing Grip
kitk-power-crushing-grip.description: Grapple a target and deal bludgeoning damage at the start of each of Monk’s turns while the grapple continues.

kitk-power-cure-wounds.name: Cure Wounds
kitk-power-cure-wounds.description: Restores HP to a living creature.

kitk-power-dark-illumination.name: Dark Illumination
kitk-power-dark-illumination.description: Creates dim necrotic light that outlines living creatures for Gunnus and his undead while obscuring details from others.
kitk-power-dark-illumination.resolution: Wisdom save to see through the illusion

kitk-power-darkness.name: Darkness
kitk-power-darkness.description: Creates magical darkness. Creatures without a relevant sense are effectively blinded in it.
kitk-power-darkness.resolution: No save; blocked by qualifying magical light

kitk-power-death-ward.name: Death Ward
kitk-power-death-ward.description: The first time the target would drop to 0 HP before the duration ends, it drops to 1 HP instead; an instant-kill effect is negated once.

kitk-power-deathfire-grasp.name: Deathfire Grasp
kitk-power-deathfire-grasp.description: Necrotic fire seizes a creature. A failed save also prevents reactions and healing until the end of its next turn.
kitk-power-deathfire-grasp.resolution: Constitution save; half damage on success

kitk-power-detect-ailment.name: Detect Ailment
kitk-power-detect-ailment.description: Reveals poison, disease, curse, ongoing damage, and abnormal condition sources affecting visible creatures or evidence.
kitk-power-detect-ailment.resolution: Wisdom (Medicine or Nature) check when the cause is concealed

kitk-power-dispel-magic.name: Dispel Magic
kitk-power-dispel-magic.description: Ends one spell, magical trap, curse layer, or magical environmental effect that qualifies.
kitk-power-dispel-magic.resolution: Automatic for low-tier effects; otherwise Charisma check against DC 10 + effect tier

kitk-power-dragons-breath.name: Dragon's Breath
kitk-power-dragons-breath.description: Exhales elemental energy chosen when used: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.
kitk-power-dragons-breath.resolution: Dexterity save; half damage on success

kitk-power-eardrum-splitter.name: Eardrum Splitter
kitk-power-eardrum-splitter.description: A sonic burst deafens failed targets and can shatter fragile glass or expose hollow walls.
kitk-power-eardrum-splitter.resolution: Constitution save; half damage and no Deafened on success

kitk-power-earth-shatter.name: Earth Shatter
kitk-power-earth-shatter.description: Fractures stone, knocks failed targets Prone, breaks brittle cover, and may reveal hollow floors or tunnels.
kitk-power-earth-shatter.resolution: Dexterity save; half damage and no Prone on success

kitk-power-eldritch-blast.name: Eldritch Blast
kitk-power-eldritch-blast.description: Fire separate beams of force. Beams may target one or several creatures.
kitk-power-eldritch-blast.resolution: Ranged power attack against each beam target

kitk-power-encanto.name: Encanto
kitk-power-encanto.description: Magically charms a creature that can hear or perceive the performance. A hostile target repeats the save after taking damage.

kitk-power-false-bravado.name: False Bravado
kitk-power-false-bravado.description: Gain temporary HP and Advantage on the next save against Frightened before the end of the next turn.

kitk-power-fiery-whips-of-vengeance.name: Fiery Whips of Vengeance
kitk-power-fiery-whips-of-vengeance.description: Fiery whips pull targets up to 10 feet. A target pulled into a hazard resolves that hazard normally.
kitk-power-fiery-whips-of-vengeance.resolution: Melee power attack against each target

kitk-power-fire-arrows.name: Fire Arrows
kitk-power-fire-arrows.description: Ammunition ignites on impact; can light webs, oil, torches, and other flammable objects.

kitk-power-flaming-sphere.name: Flaming Sphere
kitk-power-flaming-sphere.description: Creates a rolling 5-foot sphere that ignites webs and flammable terrain.
kitk-power-flaming-sphere.resolution: Dexterity save when rammed or ending adjacent; half damage on success

kitk-power-force-of-nature.name: Force of Nature
kitk-power-force-of-nature.description: A burst of roots, wind, or stone pushes a creature 10 feet or creates one 5-foot square of difficult terrain.

kitk-power-guidance.name: Guidance
kitk-power-guidance.description: Target adds 1d4 to one chosen ability check before the duration ends.

kitk-power-heart-halting-assault.name: Heart-Halting Assault
kitk-power-heart-halting-assault.description: On a hit, deal massive force damage. A failed save Stuns the target; a non-boss reduced to 0 HP is defeated immediately.

kitk-power-hideous-laughter.name: Hideous Laughter
kitk-power-hideous-laughter.description: A failed target becomes Prone and Incapacitated with laughter.
kitk-power-hideous-laughter.resolution: Wisdom save; repeat after damage and at end of turn

kitk-power-holy-wrath.name: Holy Wrath
kitk-power-holy-wrath.description: Radiant force damages hostile creatures; undead and fiends have Disadvantage on the save. Allies may immediately move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
kitk-power-holy-wrath.resolution: Constitution save; half damage on success

kitk-power-hope.name: Hope
kitk-power-hope.description: Choose up to proficiency-bonus allies. Each gains Advantage on the next saving throw and can immediately end Frightened on itself.

kitk-power-icicle-blast.name: Icicle Blast
kitk-power-icicle-blast.description: Launches piercing ice; a hit reduces speed by 10 feet until the user’s next turn.
kitk-power-icicle-blast.resolution: Ranged power attack against each target

kitk-power-imprison.name: Imprison
kitk-power-imprison.description: A radiant or divine prison restrains and silences one creature. The target repeats the save at the end of each turn.

kitk-power-influence.name: Influence
kitk-power-influence.description: Improves attitude by one step or compels a brief truthful, non-self-destructive response. Cannot force a final accusation or hidden-card reveal.

kitk-power-invisibility.name: Invisibility
kitk-power-invisibility.description: Target becomes Invisible until it attacks, deals damage, forces a save, or uses a hostile power.

kitk-power-lady-luck.name: Lady Luck
kitk-power-lady-luck.description: The ally rerolls the d20 and must use the new result. Each creature can receive Lady Luck once per short rest.
kitk-power-lady-luck.resolution: Triggered after an ally rolls a d20

kitk-power-locate-traps-and-passageways.name: Locate Traps and Passageways
kitk-power-locate-traps-and-passageways.description: Detects the presence and direction of traps, locks, secret passages, concealed doors, and structurally false walls.
kitk-power-locate-traps-and-passageways.resolution: No roll for presence; Investigation or Perception may reveal exact mechanism

kitk-power-mage-armor.name: Mage Armor
kitk-power-mage-armor.description: Sets the target’s base AC to 13 + Dexterity modifier while unarmored.

kitk-power-might-of-kord.name: Might of Kord
kitk-power-might-of-kord.description: One creature gains Advantage on its next Strength check, Strength save, shove, grapple, or forced-door attempt.

kitk-power-orbs-of-wonder.name: Orbs of Wonder
kitk-power-orbs-of-wonder.description: Launches two unstable orbs. On each hit, roll or select a readable Wild Magic rider: light, push, spark, frost, harmless sound, or color mark.

kitk-power-paralyzing-blow.name: Paralyzing Blow
kitk-power-paralyzing-blow.description: On a hit, a failed save Paralyzes the target until the end of Monk’s next turn. Bosses become Stunned instead.

kitk-power-persisting-death-curse.name: Persisting Death Curse
kitk-power-persisting-death-curse.description: Curses a target. The first time each round it takes damage, it takes additional necrotic damage and cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn.

kitk-power-phantasmal-killer.name: Phantasmal Killer
kitk-power-phantasmal-killer.description: A failed target is Frightened and takes psychic damage at the end of its turns until it succeeds.
kitk-power-phantasmal-killer.resolution: Wisdom save; repeat at end of each turn

kitk-power-poison-spray.name: Poison Spray
kitk-power-poison-spray.description: A noxious spray poisons and damages one target.

kitk-power-radiant-prayer.name: Radiant Prayer
kitk-power-radiant-prayer.description: Allies gain temporary HP; undead enemies take radiant damage and cannot take reactions on a failed save.
kitk-power-radiant-prayer.resolution: Charisma save for hostile undead; allies require no save

kitk-power-ray-of-frost.name: Ray of Frost
kitk-power-ray-of-frost.description: Cold slows the target by 10 feet until the start of the user’s next turn.

kitk-power-restore-person.name: Restore Person
kitk-power-restore-person.description: Returns a dead or permanently downed hero to life at half maximum HP, ends poison and one curse, and removes ordinary disease. Cannot restore a hero whose elimination was caused by a scenario-specific irreversible effect.
kitk-power-restore-person.resolution: No roll; must be used within the two-round restoration window for a dead hero

kitk-power-restrain.name: Restrain
kitk-power-restrain.description: Arcane bindings impose the Restrained condition. The target repeats the save at the end of each turn.
kitk-power-restrain.resolution: Strength save at end of each turn

kitk-power-revivify.name: Revivify
kitk-power-revivify.description: Returns the target to life with 1 HP. Does not remove curses, poison, disease, or missing body parts.
kitk-power-revivify.resolution: No roll; target died within the last two rounds

kitk-power-scorched-soul.name: Scorched Soul
kitk-power-scorched-soul.description: Unarmed and melee attacks deal extra fire damage; creatures hitting Monk in melee take fire damage once per turn.

kitk-power-scourge.name: Scourge
kitk-power-scourge.description: Radiant-necrotic judgment harms a creature. Undead take additional radiant damage.
kitk-power-scourge.resolution: Constitution save; half damage on success

kitk-power-self-teleport.name: Self Teleport
kitk-power-self-teleport.description: Teleport to a space you can see. This movement does not trigger opportunity attacks.
kitk-power-self-teleport.resolution: No roll if destination is visible and unoccupied

kitk-power-senseless.name: Senseless
kitk-power-senseless.description: A failed target is Blinded and Deafened and cannot take reactions.
kitk-power-senseless.resolution: Wisdom save; repeat at end of each turn

kitk-power-sorcerers-grasp.name: Sorcerer's Grasp
kitk-power-sorcerers-grasp.description: A spectral hand pulls an unattended object up to 15 feet or pulls a failed creature 10 feet. It can operate visible switches, doors, evidence, or traps from range.
kitk-power-sorcerers-grasp.resolution: Strength save against power save DC

kitk-power-spare-the-dying.name: Spare the Dying
kitk-power-spare-the-dying.description: The target becomes Stable. This does not restore HP or revive a dead hero.
kitk-power-spare-the-dying.resolution: No roll; target must have 0 HP and not be dead

kitk-power-stone-flesh.name: Stone Flesh
kitk-power-stone-flesh.description: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and Advantage against forced movement.

kitk-power-teleportation-doorway.name: Teleportation Doorway
kitk-power-teleportation-doorway.description: Creates two linked doorways. Creatures may step through by spending 5 feet of movement.
kitk-power-teleportation-doorway.resolution: No roll; endpoints must be visible, known, or previously discovered

kitk-power-tidal-wave.name: Tidal Wave
kitk-power-tidal-wave.description: Water crashes through the area, knocks failed targets Prone, extinguishes fire, and washes away loose residue.
kitk-power-tidal-wave.resolution: Dexterity save; half damage on success

kitk-power-tornado.name: Tornado
kitk-power-tornado.description: A violent vortex lifts failed targets, moves them up to 20 feet, and knocks them Prone when they land.
kitk-power-tornado.resolution: Strength save; half damage and no lift on success

kitk-power-true-strike.name: True Strike
kitk-power-true-strike.description: The attack deals its normal damage plus radiant or psychic damage.
kitk-power-true-strike.resolution: Make one weapon attack using Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity

kitk-power-turn-the-tide.name: Turn the Tide
kitk-power-turn-the-tide.description: Add or subtract 1d4 from the triggering roll after seeing the roll but before the outcome is finalized. A creature can benefit only once per round.
kitk-power-turn-the-tide.resolution: Triggered when a creature succeeds or fails a D20 Test by 2 or less

kitk-power-undead-warrior.name: Undead Warrior
kitk-power-undead-warrior.description: Summons or raises one Undead Warrior under Gunnus’s control. Only one may be active unless a higher-level feature states otherwise.

kitk-power-underworld-flames.name: Underworld Flames
kitk-power-underworld-flames.description: Hellfire erupts and leaves burning ground until the start of the user’s next turn.
kitk-power-underworld-flames.resolution: Dexterity save; half damage on success

kitk-power-vampiric-touch.name: Vampiric Touch
kitk-power-vampiric-touch.description: On a hit, deal necrotic damage and regain HP equal to half the damage dealt.

kitk-power-whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
kitk-power-whirlwind.description: Spin and strike all adjacent enemies. Apply the weapon or unarmed damage once to each hit.
kitk-power-whirlwind.resolution: One melee attack against each chosen adjacent creature

kitk-power-wind-of-the-mighty.name: Wind of the Mighty
kitk-power-wind-of-the-mighty.description: Impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack and push creatures or loose hazards in the cone 5 feet on a failed Strength save.
kitk-power-wind-of-the-mighty.resolution: Triggered when Monk or an adjacent ally is targeted by a ranged attack

kitk-power-windforce-punch.name: WindForce Punch
kitk-power-windforce-punch.description: A compressed-air strike pushes failed targets up to 20 feet and knocks them Prone if they collide with a solid surface.
kitk-power-windforce-punch.resolution: Strength save; half damage and no push on success

system:healing.name: Healing Aura
system:healing.description: A warm restorative aura surrounds the healed character.

detect-magic.name: Detect Magic
detect-magic.description: A translucent magical blanket washes across the current room and outlines magical auras, glyphs, wards, curses, illusions, and spell traps.
